headline: Emergency on the 500 kV "L-503" power transmission line supplying electricity to the Fergana Valley has been eliminated
summary: A 500 kV transmission line, L-503, serving the Fergana valley was restored on 22 November after a support tower collapsed in bad weather on 19 November. Power transmission resumed.
why: Transmission lines carry bulk electricity between regions, so outages affect grid reliability and the energy supply of industry and households.
original_headline: Farg‘ona vodiysiga elektr energiyasi uzatuvchi 500 kVli “L-503” tarmog‘idagi avariya bartaraf etildi
